headline: On October 16, 1975: Rahima Banu, last smallpox case
captionCards: Her case led to smallpox's global eradication by 1980
instagramCaption:
Rahima Banu, a three-year-old from Bangladesh, made history. \\[Blank Line] On October 16, 1975, she was the last known person to be infected with naturally occurring Variola major, the more deadly variety of smallpox. This marked a significant milestone in the global effort to eradicate the disease. Her case highlighted the importance of vaccination and public health initiatives. \\[Blank Line] Why do you think eradicating smallpox was such a monumental achievement? \\[Blank Line] Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
